# Chapter 15 · Dependent Data and Time-Series Foundations {.unnumbered}
*Stationarity · Ergodicity · Prediction · Long-Run Variance · HAC Inference*

한 개의 긴 dependent realization만 관측할 때 population moments를 어떻게 학습하고, sampling uncertainty를 어떻게 계산할 것인가를 다룬다. stationarity, ergodicity, white noise, MDS, innovations, Wold decomposition, long-run variance, dependent-data OLS, HAC/Newey–West inference를 체계적으로 연결한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **15.1–15.5** dependent sequences, filtration, stationarity, autocorrelation, ergodic theorem
- **15.6–15.8** white noise, MDS, innovations, Wold decomposition, long-run variance
- **15.9–15.11** dependent-data OLS, HAC/Newey–West, dynamic specification versus robust inference
- **15.12–15.14** linear-process preview, limits of stationarity, summary and exercises
:::
